records.name: Fake Death
records.skill_description: Feign being knocked out by falling into Yamcha's death pose, then rise with a surprise kick that can counterattack nearby opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: Activation makes the user fall into Yamcha's fake-KO pose and remain there while the input is held; the sequence and get-up kick have documented invulnerability frames. Releasing the input produces the surprise kick. Exact frame durations and version-specific punish windows are intentionally not promoted.
records.acquisition_notes: Yamcha's Initiation Test is the documented mentor-training endpoint and first lesson/reward for Fake Death. Independent mentor references corroborate the training sequence.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest drop or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: The skill's distinctive property is its invulnerability during the fake-death sequence and get-up. Historical player reports discuss balance changes, so exact frame behavior should be treated as version-sensitive.
